evidence.quote: The Economics, Governance and Decision-Making (EGDM) programme is made for you. Study in English

notes: Tuition left out: the only supplied fee page (https://www.unipd.it/simulatore-calcolo-contributi) gives a general ISEE-band table for non-EU students and does not state one lowest and one highest fee for this programme's applicant, so no single amount or range can be quoted. No intake/deadline, application channel, document list or entry requirements stated for the EGDM Bachelor's programme in the supplied pages: the admission notices and international-student pages concern other (Master's) programmes.
